title: Hollywood Agent - The Silver Empire
author: According-Sail-7884
selftext:
After months of development, I finally released the first public version of my indie game, Hollywood Agent.

It's a management simulation where you run a talent agency, recruit actors, send them to auditions, improve their skills, manage finances, compete with rival agencies and follow their careers over multiple years.

Actors can become stars, abandon your agency, retire, die, win awards, star in blockbuster movies or spend years struggling to find success.

I was inspired by classic tycoon and management games and wanted to explore a theme that I rarely see in the genre: the entertainment industry.

I'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback.
